flows.name: Setup
flows.summary: Add the GlanceDefaultUI package and initialize the SDK with setVisitorParams. Set a delegate before starting sessions to receive callbacks.

steps.title: Add the SDK (first step)
steps.description: The first step to integrate the SDK is to add it via Swift Package Manager (use the latest version or whatever version is specified) or, if you prefer, to add XCFrameworks downloaded from the public repo https://gitlab.com/glance-sdk-public/glance-framework-ios. Options: (1) SPM in Xcode: File > Add Package Dependencies, URL https://gitlab.com/glance-sdk-public/glance-default-ui-ios-releases, select latest or a specific version (get latest via get_version_info(platform='ios', repo='default_ui') or get_requirements('ios'); see integration version_guidance). (2) SPM in Package.swift: add the .package dependency with the desired version and link GlanceDefaultUI to your target. (3) Branch/fork: clone https://gitlab.com/glance-sdk-public/glance-default-ui-ios-releases and add as local package in Xcode or reference in Package.swift. (4) XCFrameworks: download from https://gitlab.com/glance-sdk-public/glance-framework-ios and embed the .xcframework(s) in your app target. GlanceSDK is pulled in automatically when using SPM or the Default UI repo.
steps.code_snippet:
// SPM in Package.swift — use latest version from get_version_info(platform='ios', repo='default_ui') or get_requirements('ios'):
.package(name: "GlanceDefaultUI", url: "https://gitlab.com/glance-sdk-public/glance-default-ui-ios-releases.git", from: "<LATEST>")

steps.title: Set visitor params
steps.description: Call setVisitorParams with GlanceVisitorInitParams (groupid required; visitorid and video optional). Required before start() or setPresence().
steps.code_snippet: let params = GlanceVisitorInitParams(); params.groupid = 33333; params.visitorid = "optionalVisitorId"; params.video = false; GlanceDefaultUI.setVisitorParams(params)

steps.title: Set delegate (recommended)
steps.description: Assign a GlanceUIDelegate to receive session code, errors, and lifecycle callbacks. Call setDelegate before start() or startHostedSession().

flows.name: Start a session
flows.summary: Start a visitor-initiated session. Default UI shows App Share (or App Share + Video) dialog, then session key for the agent to join.

steps.title: Start with key and video mode
steps.description: Call start(key:timeout:videoMode:). Use nil key for random 4-digit session key. VideoMode: VideoOff, VideoSmallVisitor, VideoLargeVisitor, VideoSmallMultiway, VideoLargeMultiway.
steps.code_snippet: GlanceDefaultUI.start(key: nil, timeout: nil, videoMode: VideoOff)

steps.title: User accepts dialog
steps.description: Default UI shows terms and Accept/Cancel. On Accept, SDK obtains session key; your delegate receives receivedSessionCode(_:). Default UI shows the code dialog.

steps.title: Waiting for agent
steps.description: When session is connected and waiting for agent, delegate receives sessionConnected(dismissAction:). When agent joins, delegate receives sessionAgentConnected(). Then session screen share (and optional video) UI is shown.

delegate_calls.when: Session connected, waiting for agent to join
delegate_calls.note: Default UI shows waiting dialog; dismissAction allows user to cancel.
sessionCode is the 4-digit key to share with agent.
Default UI hides waiting dialog and starts screen share.
sessionKey is the key of the session that ended.
Optional; only if timeout was set in setVisitorParams.
Optional; only if timeout was passed to start().

flows.name: Start a session with video
flows.summary: Start a session with one-way or two-way video. Set params.video = true in setVisitorParams, then call start with a video mode.

steps.title: Enable video in params
steps.description: Set video = true on GlanceVisitorInitParams before setVisitorParams. Request camera permission (e.g. AVCaptureDevice.requestAccess) before starting.

steps.title: Start with video mode
steps.description: Call start with VideoSmallVisitor, VideoLargeVisitor, VideoSmallMultiway, or VideoLargeMultiway. Default UI presents App Share + Video dialog (camera preview, terms).

steps.title: Video lifecycle (delegate)
steps.description: Before/during dialog: didStartPreviewVideoCapture, didStopPreviewVideoCapture. After agent joins: didStartVideoCapture, didStopVideoCapture; didStartAgentViewer, didStopAgentViewer when agent video view is shown/hidden; onUpdateAgentVideo when agent video state changes; receivedVideoCaptureImage for visitor frame. If agent requests video during session: agentAskedForVideoSession then askForVideoSession(confirmAction:cancelAction:). Widget changes: onUpdateVisibility, onUpdateLocation, onUpdateSize. Pause: didPauseVisitorVideo.

delegate_calls.when: Visitor video capture starts/stops in session

delegate_calls.note: Default UI shows Share Video dialog.

delegate_calls.when: SDK needs confirmation to start video

flows.name: Enable Presence (1-Click Connect)
flows.summary: Allow agents to initiate sessions to the visitor. Set visitorid in params, then setPresence(true). When agent sends a session request, Default UI shows terms dialog.

steps.title: Set visitor id and enable presence
steps.description: Use a stable visitorid (e.g. from CRM) so agents can target this user. Call setPresence(true) and setVisitorParams with the same params (screenshare is set internally when presence is on).

steps.title: Handle presence and session callbacks
steps.description: When presence connects: presenceDidConnect(). When it disconnects: presenceDidDisconnect(). When agent requests a session: presenceShowTerms(sessionParams:) — Default UI shows Start or Share Video dialog and handles accept/decline. Then session flow runs: receivedSessionCode, sessionConnected, sessionAgentConnected, sessionEnded. On presence timeout: presenceTimeoutExpired(). When session starts via presence: presenceSessionStarted().

delegate_calls.when: Then same as Start a session

flows.name: Join a session (agent side)
flows.summary: How the agent joins a session started by the visitor: go to join page, sign in, enter the session key. No delegate on the mobile app for this step.

steps.title: Agent joins
steps.description: Agent goes to www.glance.net/agentjoin, logs in with Glance credentials, enters the 4-digit session key the visitor shared (e.g. over voice). Glance does not include voice; use your existing voice channel.

flows.name: End session
flows.summary: End the current session from the app. Default UI can show an end-session confirmation dialog. Delegate receives sessionEnded.

steps.title: End session
steps.description: Call endSession(). Cleans up and notifies delegate sessionEnded(sessionKey:).

delegate_calls.note: sessionKey is the key of the session that ended (nil if not applicable).

flows.name: Hosted session
flows.summary: Agent-initiated session: agent logs in with Glance credentials; guest does not need group ID. Join via joinssn protocol, /visitor/join, or URL with username and key.

steps.title: Start hosted session
steps.description: Call startHostedSession(username:password:) with the agent's Glance credentials. Set delegate before calling.

steps.title: Handle hosted session callbacks
steps.description: Implement hostedSessionDidStart(sessionKey:) to show the session key to the agent; implement hostedSessionDidEnd(errorMessage:) to handle errors and cleanup (e.g. show alert if errorMessage is non-empty). Default UI shows the key dialog and handles errors.
steps.code_snippet: func hostedSessionDidStart(sessionKey: String) { /* show key */ }; func hostedSessionDidEnd(errorMessage: String) { if !errorMessage.isEmpty { /* show error */ } }

steps.title: Stop hosted session
steps.description: Call stopHostedSession() when the agent wants to end the hosted session.

delegate_calls.note: sessionKey is the key for the agent to join.
errorMessage non-empty if an error occurred.

flows.name: Errors and timeouts
flows.summary: Delegate methods called when errors or configurable timeouts occur. Implement these to inform the user or log.

steps.title: Handle errors
steps.description: onError(_ error: GlanceError) is called when an error occurs in any flow. error.code matches EventCode; error.message is the description. Show an alert or log as in the sample app.

steps.title: Handle timeouts
steps.description: If you pass timeout in setVisitorParams: initTimeoutExpired() when init does not complete in time. If you pass timeout in start(): startTimeoutExpired() when no agent joins in time. If presence is on: presenceTimeoutExpired() when presence connection times out. Implement to prompt the user or retry.

flows.name: Content masking
flows.summary: Mask sensitive UI from the agent during screen share. Use Glance (core SDK) APIs—import GlanceSDK: addMaskedView for UIViews; for SwiftUI use .addMaskedView(withLabel:) or wrap in UIHostingController and mask its view; for WebView use GlanceMaskContentController.

steps.title: Mask UIView
steps.description: Call Glance.addMaskedView(view, withLabel: "Label") to mask a UIView. Agent sees a redaction and optional label. Remove with Glance.removeMaskedView(view).

steps.title: Mask SwiftUI view
steps.description: Wrap SwiftUI view in UIHostingController and mask hostingController.view, or a specific subview.

steps.title: Mask WebView content
steps.description: Use GlanceMaskContentController with CSS selectors and labels, set on WKWebViewConfiguration.userContentController before creating the WKWebView. WebView masking displays while the WebView's isHidden is false or the WebView is destroyed. When the WebView is off-screen or in a tab, set webView.isHidden = true when it is not visible and webView.isHidden = false when it becomes visible again so the agent does not see content when the tab is switched away.
steps.code_snippet: let controller = GlanceMaskContentController("#licenseNumber, #ssn", labels: "License Number, SSN"); config.userContentController = controller

flows.name: Localization
flows.summary: Override or add localized strings. Default UI loads from main bundle first, then module bundle. Add or edit Localizable.strings; add new .lproj folders for other languages.

steps.title: Edit strings
steps.description: Strings are in GlanceDefaultUI Resources/Localizable (en.lproj/Localizable.strings). Keys include GLANCE_DEFAULT_UI_START_DIALOG_TITLE, GLANCE_DEFAULT_UI_AGENT_CODE_TEXT, GLANCE_DEFAULT_UI_PRESENCE_DIALOG_TITLE, etc. Copy Localizable.strings into your app bundle or a new .lproj to override.

steps.title: Add language
steps.description: Create e.g. es.lproj, copy Localizable.strings, translate values. Module loads from main bundle first, then DialogsCoordinator bundle.
